title: Medical Receptionist: Front Desk Korean
subtitle: Hospital reception and patient registration in Korean

sentences.en: Good morning. Is this your first visit to our clinic today?
Please show me your health insurance card and identification.
Please fill out this patient registration form with your personal and medical information.
sentences.target: 이 환자 등록 양식에 개인 정보와 병력을 기재해 주세요.

sentences.en: Your appointment is at two o'clock — the doctor will be with you shortly after you are registered.
sentences.target: 예약 시간은 오후 2시입니다. 등록이 완료되면 곧 진료해 드리겠습니다.

sentences.en: Your copayment today is ten thousand won — cash or card?
sentences.target: 오늘 본인 부담금은 1만 원입니다. 현금 또는 카드로 결제하시겠습니까?

sentences.en: We will call you when your test results are ready, usually within two business days.
sentences.target: 검사 결과가 나오면 연락드리겠습니다. 보통 영업일 기준 2일 이내입니다.

sentences.en: Would you like to make a follow-up appointment before you leave today?
sentences.target: 오늘 가시기 전에 다음 진료 예약을 하시겠습니까?

sentences.en: If you need to cancel, please let us know at least one day in advance.
sentences.target: 취소하실 경우 최소 하루 전에 알려 주시기 바랍니다.
